name: PixelBlast-TS-TW
title: Pixel Blast
description: A field of small coloured pixel shapes drifts like noise across the panel, and each click sends a spreading ring through it. A liquid wobble can distort the pattern near the pointer.
use: A playful landing page wants an interactive dotted backdrop that reacts to clicks.
avoid: You need something visible on first paint: the recording shows no pattern at all, so verify it renders before shipping.
a11y: The canvas has an aria-label but no keyboard route to the click ripples and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: In every recorded frame the panel is flat black with a bold white heading and a line of grey text centred in it. Nothing of the pixel field, its colour or its texture is visible.
behaves: Nothing changes across the frames: the headline stays fixed and no ripple or pixel motion appears. Per the code, clicks push a ring through the dot field and pointer movement can wobble a liquid layer.
customise: Shape variant, pixel size and jitter, colour, pattern scale and density, ripples, liquid distortion, speed, edge fade and transparency are props.
weight: heavy: A Three.js shader with an optional liquid pass renders every frame.
